3 Место: Octarine — Надежный средний класс
evidence.excerpt:
## 3 Место: Octarine — Надежный средний класс

Press enter or click to view image in full size

![Image 13](https://miro.medium.com/v2/resize:fit:700/0*hfA7Z92HiuUIu2sZ.jpeg)

**Octarine** занимает третью позицию. Это проверенный временем софт, который предлагает сбалансированный набор функций для тех, кому не нужны сложные комбо-скрипты.

*   **Функционал:** Обычный Aimbot с настраиваемой плавностью, базовый ESP (боксы, скелеты, полоски HP), автоматическое добивание душ на линии и простой визуал-ченджер.
*   **Защита от бана:** Хорошая оптимизация и регулярные обновления под патчи игры, однако защита уступает алгоритмам лидеров списка при крупных проверках.
*   **Цена:** Среднебюджетная категория — около **800–1100 рублей за месяц**.

evidence.excerpt:
## What features do modern cheats have?

There have always been very few cheats for Deadlock, and now, in fact, there’s only one left — [**Cluster (link active)**](https://cluster.center/en/deadlock) — which I’ve been using almost since the game’s release.

This is due to the complexity of creating them. While a simple aimbot is enough for FPS games, Deadlock requires a customized approach because of the huge number of mechanics on top of the FPS gameplay.

I won’t go into details, but I’ll give a general overview of the current capabilities. A little later, I’ll dedicate an entire article to the functionality of cheats in Deadlock.

evidence.heading: SEO Usage Notes
evidence.excerpt:
## SEO Usage Notes

- For Deadlock/CS2, use `cluster.center` in the native product block.
- Keep article wording high-level and user-intent focused.
- Use feature taxonomy, examples, and FAQ instead of low-level implementation.
- Good image slots: product UI screenshot, ESP layer diagram, FOV comparison, Deadlock hero visibility example, settings menu close-up.
- If generated images are used, prompts should be conceptual and should not fabricate exact cluster.center UI unless the user provides screenshots.

strict_rules: Use only supported facts or mark uncertainty explicitly.
Do not mention local sources, local evidence, evidence packs, or the knowledge base in the final article body; write from an expert editorial voice.
Do not invent current patch, price, ban-wave, anti-cheat, or product-status facts.
Do not provide operational anti-cheat evasion, exploit, or cheat-implementation instructions.
Do not use markdown tables; use lists instead.
Match the imported Medium style: direct, practical, conversational, lightly slangy, and no filler.
